title: Fix pre-dispatch is_destructive false positive on prohibition clauses
description: evaluate_pre_dispatch flagged read-only tasks as core-destructive because is_destructive() substring-matched hard-stop phrases even inside a prohibition. TASK-235 (read-only manifest) was blocked at claim because its guardrail named forbidden actions. Fix: added clause-scoped negation-aware contains_unnegated(); a hard-stop phrase named only inside a negated clause no longer counts, while an imperative after a clause boundary still does (safety preserved). destructive_action flag and all other gates untouched. Independent review requested from kiri before TASK-235 relies on this change.
acceptance_criteria: A task whose text names a hard-stop action only inside a prohibition clause evaluates to allow (no REQUIRE_CORE_DESTRUCTIVE_APPROVAL).
A genuine destructive imperative after a clause boundary, and any unnegated hard-stop phrase, still evaluate to require_approval.
All pre_dispatch_policy and runner_policy_gate tests pass.
